name: Manzanilla de Sanlúcar
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.
The driest and palest sherries, aged under a layer of flor yeast that keeps air away. Manzanilla is the same style aged entirely in Sanlúcar de Barrameda.

blurb.text: A DO for manzanilla, a dry wine made only from Palomino and aged under flor for at least two years in cellars in Sanlúcar de Barrameda, in Cádiz province. It ranges from pale straw to amber and has a saline taste. It can be sold fortified or unfortified.
